title: Aarav Home Decor Online — fabricated commercial substance
description: Aarav Home Decor Online has a plausible storefront, but fewer than half of payments link to orders, shipment records reuse tracking IDs, catalogue images are shared with other stores, and most sampled purchasers deny buying.

edges.label: catalogue images
edges.note: Shared stock imagery is common among small sellers. It lowers confidence in the catalogue; it does not link ownership.

edges.label: purchaser verification
edges.note: The sample result is a verification outcome, not a similarity measure; shown here to place it in the case.
